-- m/BAServlet.java --
public class BAServlet extends BWebServlet {
  void doPost(WebOp op) {
    if (!ADispatch.accept(op)) return;
    if (!target.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(p, v, op);
  }
}
-- m/ADispatch.java --
final class ADispatch {
  static boolean accept(WebOp op) {
    // nothing to check
    return true;
  }
}
-- m/BBServlet.java --
public class BBServlet extends BWebServlet {
  void doPost(WebOp op) {
    if (!Other.accept(op)) return;
    if (!target.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(p, v, op);
  }
}
-- m/Other.java --
final class Other {
  static boolean accept(WebOp op) { return true; }
}
-- m/BDispatch.java --
final class BDispatch {
  static boolean accept(WebOp op) {
    CsrfUtil.verifyCsrfToken(op.getRequest());
    return true;
  }
}
-- m/BCServlet.java --
// CDispatch checks the token
public class BCServlet extends BWebServlet {
  void doPost(WebOp op) {
    String n = "CDispatch";
    if (!target.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(p, v, op);
  }
}

  }
